mentions.name: Independent Vet
mentions.description: This website and app helps pet parents find locally owned and corporate/PE-owned veterinary practices nearby, and now gets about 30k visitors a day.
mentions.problem: It came out of a bad experience with a dog at a veterinary practice that had been recently acquired by private equity.
mentions.audience: Pet parents looking for nearby veterinary practices.
mentions.source_excerpt: Independent Vet - a website and app that helps pet parents find locally owned (and corporate/PE owned) veterinary practices nearby.
mentions.author: packeted
